question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a grey ball, Claire has a white ball, Dave has a gold ball, Eve has a blue ball, Fred has a green ball, and Gertrude has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Eve swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Bob and Fred swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) grey ball
(C) white ball
(D) gold ball
(E) blue ball
(F) green ball
(G) black ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: teal, grey, white, gold, blue, green, black
1. Bob ↔ Eve: teal, blue, white, gold, grey, green, black
2. Alice ↔ Claire: white, blue, teal, gold, grey, green, black
3. Gertrude ↔ Eve: white, blue, teal, gold, black, green, grey
4. Bob ↔ Gertrude: white, grey, teal, gold, black, green, blue
5. Claire ↔ Eve: white, grey, black, gold, teal, green, blue
6. Bob ↔ Claire: white, black, grey, gold, teal, green, blue
7. Bob ↔ Fred: white, green, grey, gold, teal, black, blue
Alice has the white ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
